text: Aziz is watching a football match when his phone buzzes.
prefix: Aziz is watching a football match when his phone buzzes.

text: The mobile bank shows a login request from a phone he has never owned, at an address he does not know, one minute ago.
prefix: The mobile bank shows a login request from a phone he has never owned, at an address he does not know, one minute ago.

text: Under it: Approve, and This was not me.
prefix: Under it: Approve, and This was not me.

text: Aziz taps This was not me.
prefix: Aziz taps This was not me.

text: One tap.
prefix: One tap.

text: What must the platform do now, and what must it not do?
prefix: What must the platform do now, and what must it not do?

text: In Lesson 30, the stranger with Aziz's SIM card tried a reset, and MyID stopped him.
prefix: In Lesson 30, the stranger with Aziz's SIM card tried a reset, and MyID stopped him.

text: This lesson follows his other try, a normal login with a guessed password, and the button that answers it.
prefix: This lesson follows his other try, a normal login with a guessed password, and the button that answers it.

text: First, how the request reached Aziz.
prefix: First, how the request reached Aziz.

text: The stranger typed Aziz's number and the correct password on a new phone.
prefix: The stranger typed Aziz's number and the correct password on a new phone.

text: Only after a correct password does a new-device request start.
prefix: Only after a correct password does a new-device request start.

text: TAF sends the code to the number, so it lands on the stranger's SIM card.
prefix: TAF sends the code to the number, so it lands on the stranger's SIM card.

text: At the same time, the platform finds Aziz's session in the mobile bank.
prefix: At the same time, the platform finds Aziz's session in the mobile bank.

text: It has rank two, so it gets the approval request.
prefix: It has rank two, so it gets the approval request.

text: The push carries no code, only the request identifier.
prefix: The push carries no code, only the request identifier.

text: The new phone needs both: the code and the approval.
prefix: The new phone needs both: the code and the approval.

text: Now Aziz refuses.
prefix: Now Aziz refuses.

text: Step one is the obvious one.
prefix: Step one is the obvious one.

text: The login on the new phone is refused, the attempt ends, and an event goes to the bank's antifraud system.
prefix: The login on the new phone is refused, the attempt ends, and an event goes to the bank's antifraud system.

text: But think about what this tap means.
prefix: But think about what this tap means.

text: The request started only after a correct password.
prefix: The request started only after a correct password.

text: So someone knows Aziz's password.
prefix: So someone knows Aziz's password.

text: And that someone may also hold his SIM card, because the code went to that number.
prefix: And that someone may also hold his SIM card, because the code went to that number.

text: Every new code and every SMS alert to that number may land in a stranger's hand.
prefix: Every new code and every SMS alert to that number may land in a stranger's hand.

text: So step two: the number goes on hold.
prefix: So step two: the number goes on hold.

text: While it is on hold, the platform starts no login that needs a one-time code to this number, on any phone or browser.
prefix: While it is on hold, the platform starts no login that needs a one-time code to this number, on any phone or browser.

text: It sends no SMS to the number at all.
prefix: It sends no SMS to the number at all.

text: Notifications go by push only.
prefix: Notifications go by push only.

text: So the marketplace website cannot help the stranger either: a web login that needs a code is refused.
prefix: So the marketplace website cannot help the stranger either: a web login that needs a code is refused.

text: And Aziz's own sessions keep working, because their access does not need the number.
prefix: And Aziz's own sessions keep working, because their access does not need the number.

text: Step three happens on the phone that refused.
prefix: Step three happens on the phone that refused.

text: The mobile bank asks Aziz to change his password, at once.
prefix: The mobile bank asks Aziz to change his password, at once.

text: He types the old one, then a new one, two times.
prefix: He types the old one, then a new one, two times.

text: As after each password change, the other sessions of the same or a lower rank end.
prefix: As after each password change, the other sessions of the same or a lower rank end.

text: Aziz's session has rank two, so every other session ends, including any that the stranger opened.
prefix: Aziz's session has rank two, so every other session ends, including any that the stranger opened.

text: Step four is one question.
prefix: Step four is one question.

text: Does your SIM card still work?
prefix: Does your SIM card still work?

text: If Aziz says yes, the stranger had only the password.
prefix: If Aziz says yes, the stranger had only the password.

text: The new password fixes that, and the hold ends.
prefix: The new password fixes that, and the hold ends.

text: If Aziz says no, the stranger has his SIM card.
prefix: If Aziz says no, the stranger has his SIM card.

text: Then the number must leave the account.
prefix: Then the number must leave the account.

text: Aziz was at level two, so first he passes a MyID re-check, on this phone.
prefix: Aziz was at level two, so first he passes a MyID re-check, on this phone.

text: Then the platform removes the number, the same way as a number reassignment, and Aziz adds a new number.
prefix: Then the platform removes the number, the same way as a number reassignment, and Aziz adds a new number.

text: His account is not blocked at any point.
prefix: His account is not blocked at any point.

text: At each step, the platform writes an audit event and sends an event to the antifraud system.
prefix: At each step, the platform writes an audit event and sends an event to the antifraud system.

text: And it sends the notification, number on hold.
prefix: And it sends the notification, number on hold.

text: Why a hold, and not a removal at once?
prefix: Why a hold, and not a removal at once?

text: I think the answer is the wrong tap.
prefix: I think the answer is the wrong tap.

text: People tap the wrong button, at eleven at night, during a football match.
prefix: People tap the wrong button, at eleven at night, during a football match.

text: If This was not me removed the number at once, one wrong tap would take away Aziz's only login.
prefix: If This was not me removed the number at once, one wrong tap would take away Aziz's only login.

text: The hold is safe and easy to undo.
prefix: The hold is safe and easy to undo.

text: The SIM question decides the rest.
prefix: The SIM question decides the rest.

text: The design pays a price for this.
prefix: The design pays a price for this.

text: SMS notifications stop while the number is on hold.
prefix: SMS notifications stop while the number is on hold.

text: And a customer who has no session on any device cannot end the hold alone.
prefix: And a customer who has no session on any device cannot end the hold alone.

text: A bank operator ends it, with a reason.
prefix: A bank operator ends it, with a reason.

text: One more detail.
prefix: One more detail.

text: Only a rank-two session can refuse.
prefix: Only a rank-two session can refuse.

text: A session of rank one, like a marketplace browser, gets a notification about the new login, but no buttons.
prefix: A session of rank one, like a marketplace browser, gets a notification about the new login, but no buttons.

text: Otherwise, a stranger with an old web session could approve his own login.
prefix: Otherwise, a stranger with an old web session could approve his own login.

text: To recap: This was not me refuses the login.
prefix: To recap: This was not me refuses the login.

text: Then the number goes on hold: no codes, no SMS, push only.
prefix: Then the number goes on hold: no codes, no SMS, push only.

text: The password changes at once, and the other sessions end.
prefix: The password changes at once, and the other sessions end.

text: Then the SIM question: yes ends the hold, no removes the number after MyID.
prefix: Then the SIM question: yes ends the hold, no removes the number after MyID.

text: Aziz said no.
prefix: Aziz said no.
